defuss-shadcn / Website / Industries / industry-practice

Doctor's Practice

A one-page site for a family doctors' practice in Germany - whether it is open right now, worked out from its hours and holidays, a closure notice, the services, the doctors and the team, the open consultation without appointment, an appointment request with the emergency numbers beside it, a repeat prescription, what new patients bring, the languages spoken and the step-free way in. Three looks: Clinic, Warm and High contrast. One of the Showcase sites.

Open full screen

Praxis am Kastanienhof, Erlenbrück

The Today card works out from the opening hours and the closures in the page (German time) whether the practice is open now and when it opens next; today's row in the week is marked. A service's link picks its reason in the appointment request; the request and the repeat prescription send to a thank-you that resets the form. The flu note is pinned beside the services. The Look select switches between Clinic, Warm and High contrast - the last one for low vision: larger type, black and white, no slanted text; it is chosen by itself when the system asks for more contrast.

×%

Built from Announcement, Site Header (its Sheet menu on a phone), Hero (split) with a Card, Section Header, Service Item, Team Member (horizontal and compact), Opening Hours, Booking Form with Radio Group, Checkbox, Date Picker, Input, Select, Textarea and an Alert, Location Map, Site Footer and Dialogs. The status is worked out by the page's script from the hours written in the Opening Hours block; the hints in the request appear with :has(). The palettes are tokens on the site's root, so every component inside follows the look; High contrast also scales the whole site with zoom.
